text:
maria: Started spruce-9b canary runs on dedicated pool (canary-p3-48). Request: full perf + cost sweep for batch sizes 1/4/8, max_seq=512. Need a quick read on whether we can promote to canary tomorrow.

ben: which model artifact/variant are we testing (fp16 / q4)? also please paste HF id.

maria: HF id: redwood/spruce-9b-v1. Ran fp16 and q4_0 so far. Raw logs: https://ci.internal/runs/4360011111 :link: 

jun: quick publish of smoke results — tl;dr: fp16 median token latency ~78ms, q4_0 ~85ms. p99s are higher (~210ms / 240ms). throughput (batch8): fp16 420 tok/s, q4_0 630 tok/s. small ~12% p99 regression vs our 7b baseline. Full paste below.

jun: ```
Config: seq=512, prompt_avg=120 tokens
fp16: p50=78ms, p95=150ms, p99=210ms, tok/s(batch1)=60, tok/s(batch8)=420
q4_0: p50=85ms, p95=170ms, p99=240ms, tok/s(batch1)=90, tok/s(batch8)=630
Cost est (tokens/hr per node): fp16 ~= $3.15/hr, q4_0 ~= $2.20/hr (rough)
Notes: KV-cache warmup reduces p50 by ~10% after ~1k tokens served; tail spikes correlate with seq>900 fallbacks
```

melissa: thanks jun. any memory pressure/ooms observed? will this fit our canary pool limits?

jun: no OOMs. GPU mem peak: fp16 ~22GB, q4_0 ~14GB. Autoscaler handled pods fine. Observed tail events when sequence length >900 (rare in our sample) causing p99 spikes ~2x — suspect tiling/fallback path.

kai: infra question — can we increase local disk cache and retry the tiling fallback path (to rule out io spikes)? cc @ops-bot

ops-bot: Scheduled ephemeral cache bump +10% on pool-canary-3 for 2 hours starting in 5m. Ticket C-3245 created.

ben: Action items from this thread:
1) Jun — run regression sweep: spruce-9b q4_0 vs horizon-7b baseline across 10k samples (randomized) and attach full percentiles + boxplots.
2) Maria — enable tiling fallback tracing on the canary config and collect traces for seq>800.
3) Melissa/Product — cost vs throughput SLO check and recommendation for canary traffic levels.
ETA: EOD tomorrow for initial consolidated report. :calendar:

maria: ack, starting the 10k sweep now and will post consolidated perf table + heatmap here. Will also upload the tiling traces once ops-bot finishes the cache bump. Tagging @product-leads for rollout decision.

product-leads: quick ask — please include a 200-prompt quality eval (hallucination + coherence checks) before promoting to wider canary. We want perf + quality paired.

maria: noted — adding eval run into the sweep. will attach the eval artifacts to the report. Thanks all :thumbsup:
